Read with validation/benchmarks/t4_djangoh_rad_noRad.py, whose header block 'THE DESIGN AND THE TOLERANCE' fixed every setting before the runs (design_block_sha256).
name: DJANGOH 4.6.21 elastic radiative tail (IEL31+IEL32+IEL33) and Born, e- 18 x p 275 GeV, four Q2 bins in the matched window; plus the eight-card control against the ePIC samples

provenance.generator: DJANGOH 4.6.21 = HERACLES 4.6.21 (banner 'VERSION 4.6.21, 05.12.2022', identical to the eight ePIC logs) with PYTHIA 6.424-dj / JETSET 7.409 / SOPHIA as shipped; HERACLES mode, integration only (START 0: no event sampling)
provenance.source_licence: NONE STATED: the GitHub API reports license = null for spiesber/DJANGOH (checked 2026-10-26) and no LICENSE file exists at the commit. The program is not vendored; only numbers it printed and the input cards of these runs are reproduced, as facts with attribution.
provenance.source_note: djangoh_h-4.6.21.f was built as djangoh_h.f; the repository's own djangoh_h.f is VERSION 4.6.20, which differs only by the version strings, the HSFLAB/HSACPT zero-transverse-momentum guards of manual sec. 15.1 and comments

manual.read: sec. 7 (radiative tail from elastic scattering, Ref. [38] = R. D. Bucoveanu and H. Spiesberger, Eur. Phys. J. A 55 (2019) 57), sec. 9.1 (INT-OPT-NC, SAM-OPT-NC, KINEM-CUTS, INT-ONLY, RNDM-SEEDS, EP-DIPOLE, FLONG), sec. 14 (kinematical cuts), sec. 15 (XIRDEL, the elastic-tail channels since HERACLES 4.6.1)

build.flags: -O -Wall -fno-automatic -fcheck=all -g -fbacktrace -ffpe-trap=invalid,zero -fallow-argument-mismatch (config.mk of the repository with LHAPDF set to the deps prefix; -pedantic removed and -fallow-argument-mismatch added: gfortran 11 refuses the REAL(4)/REAL(8) mismatch of the two PYINIT calls in djangoh_h.f, LYSTFU and HSWPDF, under -pedantic; no source line was changed)
build.lhapdf: LHAPDF 6.5.5 (the deps prefix /home/cpeng/Projects/polli/deps/install, built by .github/scripts/build_deps.sh), linked through its LHAGLUE Fortran interface (PYTHIA-type PDFSET, 'LHAPDF6 USING PYTHIA-TYPE LHAGLUE INTERFACE')

pdf.set: cteq61, LHAPDF6 SetIndex 10150, member 0 (CTEQ6.1M central; STRUCTFUNC 0 2 10150, the ePIC value)
pdf.fetched: 2026-10-26 with curl from https://lhapdfsets.web.cern.ch/current/cteq61.tar.gz (the lhapdf CLI of the prefix needs its python module, which is not built); kept outside the repository
pdf.difference_from_epic: the ePIC logs load LHAPDF 5.9.1's cteq61.LHgrid (/cvmfs/sft.cern.ch/lcg/external/lhapdfsets/5.9.1); here LHAPDF 6.5.5's lhagrid1 conversion of the same set -- an interpolation difference (and a different extrapolation below the set's Q_min = 1.3 GeV)
pdf.used_by: the DIS Born (the displayed fraction's denominator) and the control; the elastic tail carries no PDF

provenance.publishing_convention: nb per e-p collision; A = Z = 1, so per nucleus = per nucleon; unpolarised e- beam and proton

units: nb per e-p collision (A = Z = 1: per nucleus = per nucleon); every per-bin number is sigma(Q2_l >= Q2_lo) - sigma(Q2_l >= Q2_hi) of two runs with identical cards otherwise, errors in quadrature

window.definition: Q2_lo <= Q2_l < Q2_hi, 1e-5 <= x_l <= xmax(bin), 1e-4 <= y_l <= 0.985; leptonic variables (KINEM-CUTS ICUT = 3); WMIN input 0.0 GeV, raised to M_p = 0.93828 GeV by HSPRLG; xmax = Q2_lo/(Q2_lo + 9 GeV^2 - M_p^2) rounded down to 4 decimals, capped at 0.95, so W_l^2 >= 9 GeV^2 on the whole rectangle
